Watson & Hines LLP
Pearland, TX
Phone 832-555-6543
Letter of Representation
1 May 2023
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1380
Our client: Ashley Lewis
Date of loss: 10 Apr 2023
Dear Claims Representative:
This firm represents the injured party in connection with the side-impact collision that occurred at an intersection
involving your insured. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and has asked us to handle all matters arising from
it. Please direct all further communication regarding this claim to our office and do not contact our client directly,
whether by telephone, mail, or in person.
We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to your insured for this loss, along with a
copy of the declarations page confirming those limits and any other coverage that may apply, including excess or
umbrella policies.
We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, recorded
statements, dashcam or telematics data, vehicle isnpection and repair records, the claim file, adjuster notes, and any
police or incident reports in your possession. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of these materials while
the claim remanis open.
We look forward to your prompt written response confirming receipt of this letter and the steps your company will
take.
Sincerely,
Jacob Holmes
Watson & Hines LLP
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
